detection_focus: Trojanized or replaced Windows system binaries
Rootkit-style replacement of protected DLLs and EXEs
Integrity violations in Windows Resource Protection files
Corruption of component store affecting file restoration
Unexpected changes to critical system executables (cmd.exe, svchost.exe, services.exe)
forensic_artifacts: Event Log: System File Protection events
Hashes of protected system files compared to known-good baseline

flags.purpose: Scans integrity of all protected Windows system files and repairs them using cached copies.
flags.security_use_case: Restore integrity of system files potentially modified by malware or attackers.
flags.threat_detected: Modified system files indicating trojanized binaries, rootkits, or unauthorized changes.
flags.risk_if_misused: May overwrite legitimate customizations; may fail if component store is corrupted.
flags.safe_followup: Review CBS.log; run DISM /RestoreHealth if repairs fail; verify with /verifyonly.

flags.purpose: Scans and reports damaged system files without performing repairs.
flags.security_use_case: Assess integrity violations safely during investigation without altering evidence.
flags.safe_followup: Document findings; proceed with /scannow after evidence capture.

flags.purpose: Scans and repairs a specific protected system file.
flags.security_use_case: Targeted repair of suspicious critical executable identified during analysis.
flags.risk_if_misused: File path must be exact and protected; may not repair if source cache corrupted.
flags.safe_followup: Compare file hash; use DISM if repair fails; restore from installation media if required.

flags.purpose: Verifies integrity of specified files without repair.
flags.security_use_case: Check integrity of specific DLLs suspected to be compromised.
flags.threat_detected: Modified or corrupted DLLs used for persistence or code injection.
flags.risk_if_misused: Wildcard verification may be time-consuming; does not repair.
flags.safe_followup: Use /scannow for repair; review CBS.log for details.

detection_queries.command: sfc /verifyonly 2>&1 | Findstr /i /V "Windows Resource Protection did not find any integrity violations"
detection_queries.why_powerful: Displays only integrity violations for rapid assessment.
detection_queries.security_context: Quick identification of compromised system files during incident response.

detection_queries.why_powerful: Surfaces files that SFC could not repair indicating deeper compromise or image corruption.
detection_queries.security_context: Pinpointing files requiring DISM or manual restoration.

detection_queries.why_powerful: Repairs component store before restoring system files for full integrity recovery.
detection_queries.security_context: Complete recovery chain after malware damage or failed SFC repairs.

tool_relationship.attacker_usage: Attackers replace or patch system binaries to hide malware or maintain persistence.
tool_relationship.defender_usage: Verify and restore integrity of Windows protected files after compromise.
